title: Equational criterion of flatness
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $R$-module. A relation $\sum_{i=1}^{n}f_ix_i=0$ in $M$ ($n\ge0$, $f_i\in R$, $x_i\in M$) is called *trivial* if there are an integer $m\ge0$, elements $y_1,\dots,y_m\in M$ and elements $a_{ij}\in R$ ($1\le i\le n$, $1\le j\le m$) such that $x_i=\sum_{j=1}^m a_{ij}y_j$ for every $i$ and $\sum_{i=1}^n f_ia_{ij}=0$ for every $j$. Then $M$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] if and only if every relation in $M$ is trivial.
